contextMenu.description:
Right clicks are replayed, so the page's context menu opens in every view (RB-020-03). Off
by default: the browser's own menu would open in every view at once.

forms.description:
The state of form controls (select, radio, checkbox, range, ...) follows a change in the
active view (RB-020-05).

focus.description: The focused field follows the active view's focus (RB-020-05). Off by default.

navigationSettleMs.description:
How long input sync has to take the other views to the active view's page before they
load its URL, in ms (RB-020-06).

navigationIncludeHash.description:
A different fragment (`#part`) counts as a different page for navigation sync
(RB-020-06).

detectBrowsersync.description:
Switch sync off when a page carries Browsersync's client, whose ghost mode syncs by
itself (RB-020-06).

oneOf.description: The same content at the same edge: an anchor element and its offset, set directly.
Real wheel events over the same element, for pages that take over scrolling.

scrollMode.description: How scroll sync moves the other views (RB-020-04).

scrollDebounceMs.description:
How long scrolling rests before its end position is sent once more, freshly anchored, in
ms; 0 never (RB-020-04).

sync.description: What is synced between the views.

enabled.description:
`window.__rbrowser` (view info and message bus) in every view's page, from the next
document on.

uaSuffix.description: ` rBrowser/<version>` at the end of every view's user agent, an emulated one included.

pageApi.description: The page API `window.__rbrowser` and the user-agent suffix (RB-020-08).

enabled.description: Messages of a page reach the same page in the other views.

maxPayloadBytes.description: The largest payload, in bytes of its JSON text; larger ones are refused with an error.

maxPerSecond.description: Messages per second a view may send; more are dropped.

watch.description: Globs to watch, relative to the project.

oneOf.description: Reload on change (CSS only where possible).
Every change reloads the whole page.

respectHmr.description: Leave pages with their own HMR client (Vite, webpack) to their dev server.

intervalSec.description: Reload every view this often, in seconds; 0 is off.

proxy.description: Proxy server (`host:port` or a PAC URL). Local only.

network.description: Process-wide network settings; two keys are local-only ([`crate::LOCAL_ONLY_KEYS`]).

threshold.description:
How different two pixels may be and still count as equal, from 0 (exactly equal) to 1
(anything goes); anti-aliased edges are tolerated apart from it.

fullPage.description: Compare and store the whole page, not only the viewport.

oneOf.description: The path only (`/shop/cart` is `shop-cart`): every environment shares the baselines.
The host, then the path: each host has its own.
The path, then the query: `?page=2` has its own.

slugStrategy.description:
How a page's URL names its folder below `.rbrowser/baselines`: its path, the host and
the path, or the path and the query.

lfsCheck.description:
After saving a baseline, check that Git LFS tracks `.rbrowser/baselines` and is
installed, and offer the set-up when not.

failOnMetaMismatch.description:
Treat a comparison against a baseline taken with another monitor DPI, engine version,
viewport or full-page setting as an error instead of a warning.

parallel.description: Pages captured at once, each in its own hidden view (1 to 8).

waitNetworkIdle.description: Wait until the page has made no request for a moment after its load.

waitSelector.description: A CSS selector the page must show before its screenshot; empty for none.

delayMs.description: A further pause before each screenshot, in milliseconds (0 to 30000).

timeoutSec.description: The longest one page may take, from navigation to screenshot, in seconds (5 to 300).

shotTimeoutSec.description:
The longest one screenshot may take, in seconds (5 to 120); the reason of a shot that
failed is in the log and in run.json (RB-090-83).

fullPage.description: Capture the whole page, not only the viewport.

autoScroll.description: Scroll each page to its end and back first, so lazy-loaded content is there.

include.description:
Capture only the pages matching one of these patterns: a glob over the path (`/blog/**`)
or a regular expression after `re:`; empty for every page.

exclude.description: Leave out the pages matching one of these patterns (glob or `re:`).

maxPages.description: At most this many pages per run; 0 for all.

hostIntervalMs.description: The least time between two page loads on one host, in milliseconds (0 to 60000).

respectRobots.description: Leave out the pages the site's robots.txt disallows.

hideSelectors.description:
Deprecated, kept so older configs work: more elements to hide before every capture, as
CSS selectors - they join `capture.hideSelectors` (RB-080-12), which also holds the
built-in list of consent managers.

retries.description: How often a failed page is tried again (0 to 5).

maxDepth.description: How deep sitemap indexes may nest (0 to 5).

maxSitemapMib.description: The largest sitemap read, unpacked, in MiB (1 to 50).

maxUrls.description: The most pages read from the sitemaps (1 to 200000).

sitemap.description: Capture > Sitemap (RB-050-05); written only when it differs from the defaults.

environments.description:
The environment ids compared when a call names none; every environment when empty.

breakpoints.description:
The breakpoint ids compared when a call names none; every Chromium breakpoint when
empty. The settings window offers the project's breakpoints.

threshold.description:
How different two pixels may be and still count as equal, 0 to 1; `visual.threshold`
when absent.

maxDiffPercent.description:
The share of differing pixels, in percent, up to which two shots still count as the
same (0 to 100).

elementPadding.description: CSS pixels around an element screenshot, on every side.

`Ctrl+Shift+Space C D` cycles it for the session.

overviewLabels.description: The overview image shows label, size, engine and environment above each view.

hideBanners.description: Hide cookie banners, consent dialogs and chat widgets before every capture.

hideSelectors.description:
The project's own elements to hide before every capture, as CSS selectors, beside the
built-in list (at most 200).

useBuiltinList.description: Hide the elements of rBrowser's built-in list of consent managers and chat widgets.

freezeAnimations.description:
Freeze CSS animations, transitions, the caret and videos, with
`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, during every capture.

settleMs.description: The wait after hiding and freezing, before the capture, in milliseconds (0 to 5000).

fps.description: Frames per second of the file; a frame that did not change is repeated.

maxDurationSec.description: A recording stops by itself after this many seconds and its files are written.

quality.description: Image quality from 1 to 100, of the captured frames and of the encoder.

keepRecordings.description:
The Videos panel (RB-110-12): after a recording, only the newest this many recordings
rBrowser made are kept and older ones are deleted from `.rbrowser/out/video/`; 0 keeps
all. Between the project's value and the user's the one that keeps more wins.

keepDays.description:
After a recording, recordings rBrowser made older than this many days are deleted from
`.rbrowser/out/video/`; 0 keeps all. Between the project's value and the user's the one
that keeps longer wins.

autoplay.description: The Videos panel starts a recording as soon as it is chosen.

capture.description: Capture > Screenshots (RB-050-03); the user settings may set the same keys.

categories.description:
Lighthouse categories; empty runs all four. The schema names them (the settings window
offers them as a choice, RB-080-20); the plugin skips what it does not know.

parallel.description: How many check plugins run at once, counted per view.

keepRuns.description: How many check runs stay under `.rbrowser/out/checks/`; older ones are removed.

rules.description:
Per rule id (`<plugin>.<rule>`): off, or the severity its findings get. The settings
window offers the rules of the loaded check plugins by name (`x-options`, RB-080-72).

items.description: One entry of `checks.ignore`; a field left out matches anything.

rule.description: A glob of the qualified rule id.

url.description: A glob of the page URL.

selector.description: A glob of the element selector.

ignore.description:
Findings to leave out: each entry's rule id, page URL and element selector globs (`*`
any text) must all match.

oneOf.description: SARIF 2.1.0: one run per check plugin, for code-scanning viewers.
JUnit XML: one test suite per breakpoint, one test case per rule.
One HTML file that opens offline.

anyOf.description: A file format of the findings export.

defaultFormat.description:
The format of the findings panel's Export button, of the command `checks.export` and of
`rbrowser check` without `--format`.

anyOf.description: From which severity on a finding fails `rbrowser check` (exit code 1).

failOn.description: From which severity on `rbrowser check` without `--fail-on` exits with 1.

dir.description:
The folder exports are written to; empty for `.rbrowser/out/exports` in the project. A
relative folder lies below `.rbrowser/out/`; only the user settings may name an absolute
folder. MCP writes only there or below `.rbrowser/out/`.

locales.description: The locales the site is expected to have (hreflang parity).

oneOf.description: A view at every edge plus or minus 1 px.

edgeViews.description: Add a view at boundary - 1 px.

mergeTolerancePx.description: Boundaries within this many px are merged.

static.description: Also scan project files (Tailwind, SCSS, Bootstrap).

checkOnOpen.description: Look for new breakpoints when the project opens.

staticGlobs.description:
The project files the static source reads, as globs relative to the project root; the
analyser plugin's `project-read` globs bound them (RB-030-07).

items.description: One entry of `extensions[]`: a Chrome Web Store id/URL or an unpacked folder.

path.description: An unpacked extension folder, relative to the project.

extensions.description: Recommended extensions; applied only in a trusted workspace (RB-080-06).

recordScroll.description:
Scrolls are steps, consecutive scrolls of one container as one. On by default, so a
recording played back scrolls as the person did.

oneOf.description: Every hover on a menu's entry where the pointer rested `hoverDwellMs`.
Also a hover that seems to reveal what the next click hits.
The earlier form of this setting: `true` loads as `menu`, `false` as `off`.

recordHover.description:
Which hovers are steps (RB-090-81, RB-090-87): `menu` every hover on a menu's entry -
one whose hover opened a submenu, or one inside an open submenu - where the pointer
rested `hoverDwellMs`, with or without a click after it; `all` also a hover the recorder
guesses revealed what the next click hits; `off` none.

hoverDwellMs.description:
How long, in milliseconds, the pointer rests on a menu's entry before its hover is a step
(RB-090-87); passing over it quicker is no step.

oneOf.description: The way to a menu's hover, and to a click while a menu is open or into one.
The way to every hover step and click.

recordPointer.description:
Which of the pointer's way a recording keeps (RB-090-87): `menu` the way to a menu's
hover and to a click while a menu is open, `all` the way to every hover step and click,
`off` none. Play and the export move the pointer along it before the step when the view
has the size it was recorded in.

recordAutofill.description:
The form autofill's fills are steps (RB-090-78): each field it set as a `fill`, `check`,
`uncheck` or `select` with the value set, a password as its placeholder.

oneOf.description: The steps back to back, each waiting only for its element.
The recorded pause before each step, at most 10 seconds.

playbackPace.description:
How a recording plays back ("Play", `recorder.play`) and how its export waits: `fast`
runs the steps back to back, each waiting only for its element; `recorded` keeps the
pause before each step as it was recorded, each pause at most 10 seconds.

followPlayback.description:
While a recording plays, the Recorder panel marks the step each view runs, a failed step
red with its reason, and scrolls the running step into sight (RB-090-84). Off, it marks
the steps but leaves the list where it is.

showLiveSteps.description:
While a recording runs, the Recorder panel lists its steps as they are recorded - the
newest marked and scrolled into sight, hovers with their pause and pointer path
(RB-090-89). Off, the steps show once the recording is saved.

insertedStepPauseMs.description:
The pause, in milliseconds, before a step added in the Recorder panel's editor
(RB-092-01), waited at the pace `recorded`; each step's own can be changed there.

confirmDelete.description:
"Delete" in the Recorder panel asks in the panel before the recording's file is deleted
(RB-090-91). Off, a click deletes it at once.

secretFields.description:
Further fields whose values are never recorded, besides password fields: a CSS path as
the recorder shows it (`#otp`), `[data-testid="..."]` or a field's accessible name. An
entry also names a URL query or fragment parameter whose value is recorded masked.

dir.description:
The recordings folder, relative to the project root; it must lie inside `.rbrowser/`
and outside the folders workspace trust protects.

oneOf.description: The recorder's rank order: test id, role and name, text, CSS path.

locatorPreference.description:
Which selector candidate a locator prefers when the element has it; the recorder's rank
order (`auto`) otherwise.

dir.description:
The exports folder, relative to the project root; it must lie inside `.rbrowser/` and
outside the folders workspace trust protects. Each export is a new folder in it.

includeConfig.description: A spec export writes its `playwright.config.ts` (one project per breakpoint) beside it.
